{{Top|leg}}
The '''mining center complex''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garos IV]]. It was the center of [[Hibridium/Legends|hibridium]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] on the planet, and was commanded by [[Major General]] [[Carner]].
